description.short_caption: Gram stain showing gram-negative diplococci and neutrophils.
description.detailed_description: This is a high-magnification image of a Gram stain. Numerous neutrophils are visible, characterized by their multi-lobed nuclei. Among the neutrophils, there are gram-negative diplococci, which appear as paired, pink-staining cocci. The background is relatively clear, with no significant debris or other organisms visible. This finding is consistent with an infectious process involving gram-negative diplococci.

description.short_caption: Histopathologic image showing intracellular and extracellular organisms stained with a special stain.
description.detailed_description: This is a histopathologic image stained with a special stain, likely Giemsa or a similar stain, highlighting numerous oval to round organisms. The organisms are present both intracellularly and extracellularly, with some clustering within host cells. The background shows a pale pink matrix, likely representing tissue or cellular debris. The organisms are stained a reddish hue, contrasting with the lighter background.
